scope: 51 deterministic 15-second C++ reference trajectories; synthetic seeds, not measured instrument data

interpretation.onset: First bowl energy crossing 1e-4 J, not an acoustic or psychoacoustic onset measurement
interpretation.displacement: Sum of absolute modal radial displacements divided by rim radius; conservative bound, not a measured shell strain
interpretation.late_windows: Means over 9–12 and 12–15 seconds; these indicate short-run trends, not asymptotic saturation proofs
interpretation.elapsed: Audited run includes diagnostic state scans, with other validation work running concurrently; not a controlled production CPU benchmark

open_gates: Measured dry strike/rub comparisons and contact calibration
Spectral aliasing and production rate conversion
Controlled Rack callback performance and 32-instance budget
